bug: nightly export job hangs on empty shard

reproduction.minimised: shard with zero rows, one worker
reproduction.bisect: input bisect: first hanging shard is 7 of 0-31; code bisect: commit 41d0e5c

hypotheses.statement: Worker waits on a queue sentinel that is never sent when the shard has no rows
hypotheses.prediction: Sending the sentinel for an empty shard lets the job finish in under 5 s

hypotheses.statement: The database connection pool is exhausted
hypotheses.prediction: Raising pool size from 4 to 16 does not change the hang

root_cause.text: export.py worker() returns before enqueueing the end-of-shard sentinel when rows is empty, so the writer thread blocks on queue.get() forever.

fix.description: Always enqueue the sentinel in a finally block
